args.message:
Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)

Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead of ROUND_HALF_UP to match the
expected behavior in tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `src/money.py` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP` while `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212).

This change switches `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented and tested behavior.

authority: Merging into main requires approval from a code owner
